title: Course Walkthrough
description: Step-by-step guide to navigating your course

data.title: Step 1: Course Home
data.description: Start at the course home page. Here you'll find important announcements and quick links to key course sections.

data.title: Step 2: Access Content
data.description: Navigate to the Content section to access all course modules, readings, and materials.

data.title: Step 3: View Assignments
data.description: Check the Assignments section to see what's due and submit your work.

data.title: Step 4: Participate in Discussions
data.description: Join course discussions to engage with your peers and instructor.

data.title: Step 5: Check Your Grades
data.description: View your grades and feedback in the Grades section.
